name: kwaivgi/kling-video/v2.6/standard/motion-control
description: Kling V2.6 Standard Motion Control by Kuaishou transfers the motion, expressions, and camera movement of a reference video onto the character in an image, producing a 720p video up to 30 seconds.

image.title: Image Url
image.description: Reference image URL. The characters, backgrounds, and other elements in the generated video are based on this reference image. Characters should have clear body proportions, avoid occlusion, and occupy more than 5% of the image area.

video.title: Video Url
video.description: Reference video URL. The character actions in the generated video will be consistent with this reference video. Should contain a realistic style character with entire body or upper body visible, including head, without obstruction. Duration limit depends on character_orientation: 10s max for 'image', 30s max for 'video'.

keep_original_sound.title: Keep Original Sound
keep_original_sound.description: Whether to keep the original sound from the reference video.

character_orientation.title: Character Orientation
character_orientation.description: Controls whether the output character's orientation matches the reference image or video. 'video': orientation matches reference video - better for complex motions (max 30s). 'image': orientation matches reference image - better for following camera movements (max 10s).

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Kling V2.6 Standard Motion Control

Kling V2.6 Standard motion control: the character in `image` performs the moves of a reference `video`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | — | Optional scene and style direction. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | Character to animate. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `video` | video URL, required | — | Reference video that supplies the motion. |
| `character_orientation` | `image` / `video` | — | `video` follows the reference video's orientation (better for complex moves, up to 30s); `image` follows the image (better for camera moves, up to 10s). |
| `keep_original_sound` | boolean | true | Keep the reference video's audio track. |

## Billing

You pay $0.07 per second of the reference video. The quote before submission assumes 30 seconds; the final charge uses the measured length.

| Reference video | Price |
|---|---|
| 5s reference | $0.35 |
| 10s reference | $0.70 |
| 30s reference | $2.10 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Match the character image's framing to the person in the video.

## Limits

- Up to 30 seconds with `character_orientation: video`, 10 seconds with `image`.
